# Tax Documentation: Submit Self-Certification Tax Documentation Data

Area overview and notes: [tax-documentation.md](../tax-documentation.md)

`POST /account-owners/{id}/tax-documentation-data/self-certification` · tenant-scoped token

Submit self-certification tax documentation data for an account owner. This endpoint allows you to collect and store self-certification form information required for tax reporting and compliance.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Your system's unique identifier for the Account Owner. |

**Response 201**: Self-certification submission created successfully

Returns the submitted body under `data`, plus:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | object | Yes |  |
| `data.active_non_financial_entity_type` | string | No | The type of active non-financial entity the account owner is completing a self-certification for. One of: `OTHER`, `INTERNATIONAL_ORGANIZATION`, `GOVERNMENT_ENTITY`, `CENTRAL_BANK`, `PUBLIC_CORPORATION`. |
| `data.financial_institution_type` | string | No | The type of financial institution the account owner is completing a self-certification for. One of: `DEPOSITORY_INSTITUTION`, `CUSTODIAL_INSTITUTION`, `INVESTMENT_ENTITY`, `INSURANCE_COMPANY`, `NON_REPORTING_FINANCIAL_INSTITUTION`. |
| `data.investment_entity_managed` | boolean | No | Indicates whether the investment entity is managed. |
| `data.is_individual` | boolean | No | Indicates whether the account owner is an individual. |
| `data.self_certification_account_type` | string | No | The type of account the account owner is completing a self-certification for. One of: `FINANCIAL_INSTITUTION`, `PASSIVE_NON_FINANCIAL_ENTITY`, `ACTIVE_NON_FINANCIAL_ENTITY`. |

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request · 401 Unauthorized · 403 Forbidden · 404 Not Found · 429 Too Many Requests
